name: KU force-reflecting
full_name: Korea University force-reflecting robotic platform for cardiac (EP) catheter navigation
group: Korea University, Korea Artificial Organ Center (Jun Woo Park, Jaesoon Choi, Kyung Sun) with Hui-Nam Pak (Yonsei University Health System) and Jung Chan Lee (Seoul National University) (park2010_development affiliations)
versions: 2010 platform (park2010_development, Artif. Organs 34(11), full); 2011 forbidden-region haptic virtual fixture on the same master-slave platform, in vitro phantom (park2011_haptic, Artif. Organs 35(11), full)
devices_driven: one conventional cardiac ablation catheter loaded with its handle (park2010 Methods); 2011: 7 Fr Blazer II HTD EP catheter (Boston Scientific) (park2011 Methods)
n_dof_detail: 3 (forward/backward translation, roll, tip-bending knob) (park2010 Methods, Fig. 1a); master 5 DOF (the 3 plus pitch and yaw for haptic rendering, Fig. 1b)
translation_detail: linear-stage+clamp: the whole catheter compartment (handle with roll and knob joints) rides a linear guide and ball screw driven by a Maxon EC-Max30 brushless motor; resolution 0.002 mm (park2010 Methods)
rotation_detail: roll joint (Maxon EC16) turns the mounted catheter and knob joint as one unit (0.037 deg resolution); knob joint: coupling socket on the bending knob driven by an EC16 and a worm drive (0.00185 deg) (park2010 Methods)
force_sensing: load cell (Dacell UMM-1kgf) between the translation joint and the catheter compartment on a sliding bearing measures the axial reaction force, 0.019 N resolution (park2010 Methods, Results); force can also be estimated from motor current (Abstract)
haptics_leader: custom 5-DOF haptic master with a catheter-handle-shaped housing: knob read by a magnetic encoder (no force feedback), roll with encoder + Maxon RE13 for feedback, translation on a wire-pulley bar with EC-Max13, plus pitch and yaw; RTLinux-Pro hosts linked by Ethernet, 1 kHz force loop (park2010 Methods); 2011: image-based forbidden-region virtual fixture rendered at the master (park2011)
imaging_compat: N.R. for X-ray; 2011 in vitro tests used a camera (Canon EOS 500D, 1080p, 20 fps, 0.37 mm/pixel) as a fluoroscopy stand-in (park2011 Methods)
validation_detail: bench: master/slave synchronisation with step, sinusoidal and manual motion, force-sensor check against a push-pull gauge (park2010 Results); phantom: the catheter inserted by teleoperation into a 600 x 400 mm vessel phantom with human-like inner radii while the virtual fixture warned of wall approach (park2011 Methods, Results); animal tests planned (park2010)
key_numbers: translation max 1000 mm/s and 83,000 mm/s^2, roll max 138 rad/s and 7,610 rad/s^2 (above the 300-700 mm/s and 11-43 rad/s required); force peaks 0.5 and 0.7 N detected, resolution 0.019 N; joint resolutions 0.002 mm / 0.037 deg / 0.00185 deg; 1 kHz synchronisation loop (park2010 Results, Methods)
